name: lazyforensic
description: Antigravity + Gemini 3.7 Flash evidence-drafting helper for JSON timelines, OS-visible file metadata, and Kakao text exports. Not a forensic acquisition or court-admissibility suite.

interface.shortDescription: Gemini 3.7 Flash DFIR drafting for Antigravity
interface.longDescription: LazyForensic is tuned for Google Antigravity + Gemini 3.7 Flash. SessionStart injects GEMINI.md. Skills use invoke_subagent (Model flash/pro/flash_lite), host Read for frames, and fail closed when evidence is missing. Vendor UI catalogs stay out of the default skill picker.
